note: Rewritten from the species description of Chhotani (1997); the original is in English, only the soldier is recorded, alates are recorded as unknown, and workers are not recorded; distribution records, synonymy citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule straw yellow, subrectangular, widest anteriorly, the anterolateral corners angular; frontal projection sharply conical, the apex raised, the anterior margin undulate, extending beyond the mandibular base; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2; mandibles slender, about as long as the head; postmentum short and club-shaped; pronotum saddle-shaped, without an anterior notch.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow; antennae pale yellow; mandibles reddish brown; pronotum and labrum paler than the head capsule; legs and abdomen nearly white. Pilosity of the head and pronotum sparse, that of the body denser. Head capsule subrectangular, widest anteriorly, the anterolateral corners angular; frontal projection sharply conical, the apex raised, the anterior margin undulate, extending beyond the mandibular base; length from head to mandibular base 1.37–1.38 mm, maximum width 0.96–0.97 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Anterior margin of the labrum deeply concave. Mandibles slender and rod-like, the apices incurved, about as long as the head; left mandible 1.38 mm, right mandible 1.30–1.33 mm. Postmentum club-shaped and short, length 0.64–0.65 mm, maximum width 0.26–0.27 mm, width at the waist 0.20–0.21 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.23–0.26 mm, maximum width 0.55–0.57 mm, without an anterior notch.
